scope: Include resubmitted rework in the date-filtered pending-QC overview card for both modes.

behavior.pendingQc: Current projected status pending_qc or pending_reqc, filtered by the latest effective submittedAt in the selected Beijing date range. Distinct current TID keys; includes first, repeated QC and acceptance-return rework submissions.
behavior.exclusions: Passed, rejected, deleted, not-yet-submitted rework and QC handling of an acceptance return are not pending QC. Admin release and ignored stale actions follow the existing workflow projection.
behavior.pendingRework: Keep its existing first-submission date cohort and last-QC condition, but require a current rework/acceptance_rework status. Resubmitted tasks no longer remain in pending rework.
behavior.audited: QC queue/filter, Flow.counts, group/movie status tables, all-task status board and report/worker current-status exports already include pending_reqc; no changes to their correct logic.
behavior.performance: Reuse cached current task projections and submittedAt; pending-QC counting no longer sorts or scans each task history. No new polling, API calls or detail DOM.
behavior.unchanged: Workflow, API, report helpers, exports, first completion, pass/return volumes, accuracy, historical records, other work modes and demos.

deployment.rollback: Restore backed-up index only with candidate SHA guard; retain all immutable assets.
